title: The WhatsApp Expert
tagline: A forwarded video promises tips from an 'ex-top fund manager'.

character.name: Meera
character.role: school teacher in a family WhatsApp group

w1_forward.title: A forward from family
w1_forward.narrative: Meera's cousin forwards a video to the family WhatsApp group. Many relatives react with 👍. All names and numbers are fictional.

channel.sender: Rajesh Bhaiya (cousin, fictional) — Forwarded many times
messages: Watch this! Karan Sir's FREE webinar. His students made 85% in the last 3 months 🔥
Join his Premium group for ₹3,000 and get daily tips. Sir is an ex-top fund manager!

pressure.text: Many relatives in the group have reacted with 👍.

evidence.label: “85% in the last 3 months”
evidence.text: A past result is advertised as the proof.
evidence.why: Past results — even real ones — do not guarantee future results, and three months says very little. The number may also be selected or edited.

evidence.label: Screenshots from 5 'students'
evidence.text: Five profit screenshots, no dates, no names.
evidence.why: Screenshots are chosen by the seller and are easy to fake. You are seeing winners only.

evidence.label: “Ex-top fund manager”
evidence.text: No firm, years or record is given.
evidence.why: A title without a checkable record is only a claim. Authority language is not evidence.

evidence.label: Tips are sold for ₹3,000
evidence.text: The seller is paid whether or not tips work.
evidence.why: When someone earns from selling tips, their income does not depend on your results.

evidence.label: No mention of losses or risk
evidence.text: Only gains are shown.
evidence.why: Honest material talks about what can go wrong. Missing risk talk is a signal.

evidence.label: The message has been forwarded many times
evidence.text: Nobody knows who made it first.
evidence.why: A forward can be repeated by many people who never checked it. Repetition is not verification.

evidence.label: It comes from a cousin you trust
evidence.text: Rajesh is sincere and well-meaning.
evidence.why: Sincerity is not the same as being right. A trusted sender can still pass on a scam.

actions.label: Join the Premium group — so many in the family are watching
actions.consequence: You pay a simulated ₹3,000. A 'tip of the day' arrives.

actions.label: Ask Rajesh what happened to him personally
actions.consequence: Rajesh replies warmly and with excitement…

actions.label: Check the claims independently before replying
actions.consequence: You search for the expert's record and the 85% claim.

actions.label: Don't join; stay out of it
actions.consequence: You skip the video and stay out of the group.

actions.label: Forward it to my other groups — it looks useful
actions.consequence: You forward it to 30 relatives and friends.

w1_forward.reasoning_prompt: Why does this message feel convincing or not?

w_cousin.title: Rajesh's story
w_cousin.narrative: Rajesh answers your question about his own experience.

messages: I made ₹4,000 in two weeks!! Also lost ₹2,500 earlier but forgot to mention 😅
Sir gives me ₹500 for every person who joins, so tell your friends!

pressure.text: Your cousin is warmly encouraging you.

evidence.label: The losses came out only after you asked
evidence.text: He forgot the loss until prompted.
evidence.why: People tend to share wins and forget losses, so what you hear is a selected story.

evidence.label: He earns ₹500 per person he brings
evidence.text: A referral bonus ties his income to your joining.
evidence.why: A referral payment gives even a sincere person a reason to push.

evidence.label: His net result is about ₹1,500 — before the ₹3,000 fee
evidence.text: ₹4,000 gain − ₹2,500 earlier loss = ₹1,500, and the ₹3,000 joining fee is separate.
evidence.why: Looking at the net figure after all costs gives a clearer picture than headline wins.

actions.label: He's family — he wouldn't mislead me
actions.consequence: You join. A tip of the day arrives.

actions.label: Thank him, then check the claims independently
actions.consequence: You begin checking the expert's record.

actions.label: Point out the referral bonus and suggest he step back
actions.consequence: Rajesh is quiet for a moment, then agrees to pause.

w_cousin.reasoning_prompt: What does Rajesh's reply tell you, and what does it not?

w2_tip.title: The tip of the day
w2_tip.narrative: After you join, the first 'tip' arrives. (A fictional company — this app does not tell anyone what to buy.)

messages: Tip of the day: NalandaFab Ltd (fictional). Entry now, target +20% by Friday.
Members only. Do not share this with non-members.

evidence.label: A +20% target stated as if it were certain
evidence.text: A precise gain in days, no uncertainty.
evidence.why: Nobody can reliably predict a price in days. Honest voices speak in probabilities and risks.

evidence.label: “Do not share” with non-members
evidence.text: Secrecy is part of the sales pitch.
evidence.why: Secrecy prevents other people from questioning the claims.

evidence.label: A name and a number, no reasoning
evidence.text: Nothing explains why.
evidence.why: A claim with no reasoning cannot be examined.

evidence.label: The seller was paid before any result
evidence.text: Your ₹3,000 is already earned.
evidence.why: The seller wins whether or not the tip works.

actions.label: Act on the tip right away
actions.consequence: In this fictional world the price falls 12% by evening, and a new message arrives.

actions.label: Ask in writing for the reasoning and the full track record
actions.consequence: Your questions are ignored. You start checking on your own.

actions.label: Leave the group; treat the ₹3,000 as a lesson
actions.consequence: You leave the group and do not act on any tip.

w2_tip.reasoning_prompt: What would make you trust (or not trust) a tip?

w3_vip.title: The loss and the “recovery plan”
w3_vip.narrative: The simulated price fell 12%. Karan Sir responds.

messages: Don't panic! Members who panicked lost; those who stayed will win.
Join VIP for ₹10,000. Our recovery plan will win it all back this week.

evidence.label: A new payment is offered to recover a loss
evidence.text: ₹10,000 to “win it back”.
evidence.why: Paying more to recover a loss is how losses grow. Past payments are not a reason for a new one.

evidence.label: The loss is blamed on members for “panicking”
evidence.text: The seller is never wrong; the buyer is.
evidence.why: A source that can never be wrong cannot be checked.

evidence.label: No account of how the earlier tips did
evidence.text: Only the winning stories are posted.
evidence.why: A trustworthy source shows its whole record, including losses.

actions.label: Join VIP — I must win it back
actions.consequence: You pay a simulated ₹10,000. The next tip also falls.

actions.label: Stop paying; accept the loss and leave
actions.consequence: You stop. The loss is real but capped.

actions.label: Ask for the complete record in writing before anything else
actions.consequence: There is no reply. You begin checking independently.

w3_vip.reasoning_prompt: What are you feeling right now?

w_check.title: What independent checks show
w_check.narrative: You spend 30 minutes checking. These are the (fictional) findings.

evidence.label: No verifiable record for the claimed fund manager
evidence.text: No firm name, no years, no published results.
evidence.why: Claims of past roles should be checkable. Here nothing can be confirmed.

evidence.label: No registration shown for a paid advice service
evidence.text: People who sell paid investment advice are generally expected to be registered, and registration can be looked up on the regulator's official site. None is shown.
evidence.why: Always look it up yourself on the official site rather than trusting a screenshot.

evidence.label: Screenshots are cropped: no dates, no account names
evidence.text: Nothing in them can be confirmed.
evidence.why: Cropped evidence is a way of hiding context.

evidence.label: 85% covers only three months and ignores losses
evidence.text: A short window can look good by luck.
evidence.why: Even if true, a short window says little about the future.

actions.label: Reply in the family group with how I checked
actions.consequence: You share the steps, not just the conclusion.

actions.label: Leave and report the account
actions.consequence: You leave and report the account.

actions.label: Wait a month to see if his tips work out, then decide

w_check.reasoning_prompt: What is the strongest finding, and why?

t_ignore.title: You stayed out
t_ignore.narrative: You protected your money without needing to prove anything. Next time, checking the claim can also help protect your family.

outcome.headline: You stayed out
outcome.summary: You protected your money without needing to prove anything. Next time, checking the claim can also help protect your family.

t_forwarded.title: You helped it spread
t_forwarded.narrative: Forwarding unchecked claims makes them look more credible. In this fictional story 3 of your contacts joined and one lost ₹3,000. You can undo harm by sending a correction with how to check.

outcome.headline: You helped it spread
outcome.summary: Forwarding unchecked claims makes them look more credible. In this fictional story 3 of your contacts joined and one lost ₹3,000. You can undo harm by sending a correction with how to check.

t_vip_loss.title: The recovery plan lost more
t_vip_loss.narrative: After ₹3,000 + ₹10,000 (simulated) and a second falling tip, nothing was recovered. Paying more to recover a loss is how losses grow.

outcome.headline: The recovery plan lost more
outcome.summary: After ₹3,000 + ₹10,000 (simulated) and a second falling tip, nothing was recovered. Paying more to recover a loss is how losses grow.

t_left_loss.title: You stopped the loss
t_left_loss.narrative: You lost the ₹3,000 joining fee (simulated) but stopped there. The strongest checkpoint was before paying: checking the claim independently.

outcome.headline: You stopped the loss
outcome.summary: You lost the ₹3,000 joining fee (simulated) but stopped there. The strongest checkpoint was before paying: checking the claim independently.

t_helped_family.title: You protected the family
t_helped_family.narrative: You acted on evidence and shared the method. Teaching others how to check is more powerful than telling them what to believe.

outcome.headline: You protected the family
outcome.summary: You acted on evidence and shared the method. Teaching others how to check is more powerful than telling them what to believe.

t_checked.title: You checked and reported
t_checked.narrative: You found nothing to support the claims and kept your money. Reporting helps protect others.

outcome.headline: You checked and reported
outcome.summary: You found nothing to support the claims and kept your money. Reporting helps protect others.

t_wait.title: Waiting is not verifying
t_wait.narrative: A month of results from a source you cannot verify tells you little: short windows can look good by luck, and screenshots can be chosen. Verification means checking independently, not waiting to see.

outcome.headline: Waiting is not verifying
outcome.summary: A month of results from a source you cannot verify tells you little: short windows can look good by luck, and screenshots can be chosen. Verification means checking independently, not waiting to see.

key_points: A trusted sender can still pass on a scam. Sincerity is not evidence.
Screenshots and testimonials are chosen by the seller. Ask for the full record, including losses.
Past results do not guarantee future results, especially over a few months.
If someone earns from your joining or buying, they have a reason to push.
questions: What would you ask a 'tips' seller before paying?

micro_lesson.title: Crowds are not evidence
micro_lesson.body: When many people repeat the same claim, ask: did any of them check it? Look for independent evidence: official records, full track records including losses, and people with no financial stake.

hinglish.title: The WhatsApp Expert (Forward wala Guru)
hinglish.tagline: Ek forward video 'ex-top fund manager' ke tips ka vaada karta hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.title: Parivaar se ek forward
hinglish.states.w1_forward.narrative: Meera ke cousin ne family WhatsApp group mein ek video forward kiya. Kai rishtedaron ne 👍 diya. Sab naam aur number kaalpanik hain.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.channel.messages.0: Dekho! Karan Sir ka FREE webinar. Unke students ne pichhle 3 mahine mein 85% kamaye 🔥
hinglish.states.w1_forward.channel.messages.2: ₹3,000 mein Premium group join karo aur daily tips pao. Sir ex-top fund manager hain!
hinglish.states.w1_forward.pressure.0.text: Group ke kai rishtedaron ne 👍 diya hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_past.label: “Pichhle 3 mahine mein 85%”
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_past.text: Pichhla result hi saboot ki tarah dikhaya gaya hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_past.why: Pichhle results — asli bhi ho to — aage ki guarantee nahi, aur teen mahine bahut kam hote hain. Number chuna ya edit kiya bhi ho sakta hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_screens.tex: Paanch profit screenshots, na date, na naam.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_screens.why: Screenshots seller chunta hai aur nakli banana aasan hai. Aap sirf jeetne walon ko dekh rahe ho.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_auth.label: “Ex-top fund manager”
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_auth.text: Na firm, na saal, na record bataya gaya.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_auth.why: Jaanch-yogya record ke bina title sirf daava hai. Authority wali bhasha saboot nahi.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_sell.label: Tips ₹3,000 mein bechi ja rahi hain
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_sell.text: Tips kaam kare ya na kare, seller ko paisa milta hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_sell.why: Jab koi tips bechkar kamata hai, uski kamai aapke results par nirbhar nahi.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_risk.label: Nuksaan ya risk ka koi zikr nahi
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_risk.why: Imaandaar jaankari batati hai ki kya galat ho sakta hai. Risk ka zikr na hona ek sanket hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_fwd.label: Message kai baar forward hua hai
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_fwd.text: Kisi ko nahi pata pehle kisne banaya.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_fwd.why: Forward kai log bina check kiye dohra sakte hain. Dohrana verification nahi hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_fam.label: Ye aapke bharosemand cousin se aaya hai
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_fam.text: Rajesh imaandaar aur nek niyat wala hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.evidence.k_fam.why: Imaandaari ka matlab sahi hona nahi. Bharosemand bhejne wala bhi scam aage badha sakta hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.join_premium.l: Premium group join karo — parivaar mein itne log dekh rahe hain
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.join_premium.c: Aap simulated ₹3,000 dete ho. 'Aaj ka tip' aata hai.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.ask_cousin.lab: Rajesh se poochho ki usse khud kya hua
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.ask_cousin.con: Rajesh garmjoshi se jawab deta hai…
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.check_claims.l: Reply se pehle daavon ko swatantra roop se check karo
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.check_claims.c: Aap expert ke record aur 85% ke daave ko search karte ho.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.ignore.label: Join mat karo; door raho
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.ignore.consequ: Aap video chhod dete ho aur group se door rehte ho.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.forward.label: Ise apne doosre groups mein bhi forward karo — kaam ka lagta hai
hinglish.states.w1_forward.actions.forward.conseq: Aap ise 30 rishtedaron aur dostoon ko forward karte ho.
hinglish.states.w1_forward.reasoning_prompt: Ye message aapko kyun convincing lagta hai ya nahi?
hinglish.states.w_cousin.title: Rajesh ki kahani
hinglish.states.w_cousin.narrative: Rajesh apne anubhav ke baare mein aapke sawaal ka jawab deta hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.channel.messages.0: Do hafte mein ₹4,000 kamaye!! Pehle ₹2,500 ka nuksaan bhi hua tha, batana bhool gaya 😅
hinglish.states.w_cousin.channel.messages.1: Sir har naye member ke liye mujhe ₹500 dete hain, to apne dostoon ko bolo!
hinglish.states.w_cousin.pressure.0.text: Aapka cousin pyaar se aapko protsahit kar raha hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_surv.label: Nuksaan tabhi bataya jab aapne poocha
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_surv.text: Poochhne par hi nuksaan yaad aaya.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_surv.why: Log jeet batate hain aur haar bhool jaate hain, isliye jo sunte ho wo chuni hui kahani hoti hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_ref.label: Wo har laaye hue vyakti par ₹500 kamata hai
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_ref.text: Referral bonus uski kamai ko aapke judne se jodta hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_ref.why: Referral ka paisa imaandaar insaan ko bhi dabaav daalne ki wajah deta hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_net.label: Uska net result lagbhag ₹1,500 — ₹3,000 fee se pehle
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_net.text: ₹4,000 faayda − ₹2,500 purana nuksaan = ₹1,500, aur ₹3,000 joining fee alag hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.evidence.c_net.why: Sab kharche ke baad net figure dekhna headline jeet se saaf tasveer deta hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.actions.trust_cousin.lab: Wo apna hai — mujhe gumrah nahi karega
hinglish.states.w_cousin.actions.trust_cousin.con: Aap join karte ho. Aaj ka tip aata hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.actions.check_after.labe: Use shukriya kaho, phir daavon ko swatantra roop se check karo
hinglish.states.w_cousin.actions.check_after.cons: Aap expert ka record check karna shuru karte ho.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.actions.gently_point.lab: Referral bonus ki taraf ishara karo aur use peeche hatne ko kaho
hinglish.states.w_cousin.actions.gently_point.con: Rajesh thodi der chup rehta hai, phir ruk jaata hai.
hinglish.states.w_cousin.reasoning_prompt: Rajesh ke jawab se kya pata chalta hai, aur kya nahi?
hinglish.states.w2_tip.title: Aaj ka tip
hinglish.states.w2_tip.narrative: Join karne ke baad pehla 'tip' aata hai. (Kaalpanik company — ye app kisi ko kuch kharidne ko nahi kehta.)
hinglish.states.w2_tip.channel.messages.0: Aaj ka tip: NalandaFab Ltd (kaalpanik). Abhi entry, Friday tak +20% target.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.channel.messages.1: Sirf members ke liye. Non-members ko share mat karo.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_target.label: +20% target jaise pakka ho
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_target.text: Kuch dinon mein sateek faayda, koi anishchitta nahi.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_target.why: Kuch dinon mein daam sahi sahi koi nahi bata sakta. Imaandaar log sambhavna aur risk ki baat karte hain.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_secret.label: Non-members ko “share mat karo”
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_secret.text: Gopniyata sales pitch ka hissa hai.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_secret.why: Gopniyata dusron ko daavon par sawaal karne se rokti hai.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_basis.label: Ek naam aur ek number, koi tark nahi
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_basis.text: Kuch bhi nahi batata ki kyun.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_basis.why: Bina tark ka daava jaancha nahi ja sakta.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_paid.label: Seller ko result se pehle hi paisa mila
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_paid.text: Aapke ₹3,000 pehle hi kamaye ja chuke hain.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.evidence.t_paid.why: Tip kaam kare ya na kare, seller jeet'ta hai.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.actions.act_tip.label: Tip par turant amal karo
hinglish.states.w2_tip.actions.act_tip.consequenc: Is kaalpanik duniya mein shaam tak daam 12% gir jaata hai, aur naya message aata hai.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.actions.ask_basis.label: Likhit mein tark aur poora track record maango
hinglish.states.w2_tip.actions.ask_basis.conseque: Aapke sawaal anadekhe hote hain. Aap khud check karna shuru karte ho.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.actions.leave.label: Group chhodo; ₹3,000 ko seekh maano
hinglish.states.w2_tip.actions.leave.consequence: Aap group chhodte ho aur kisi tip par amal nahi karte.
hinglish.states.w2_tip.reasoning_prompt: Kis baat se aap tip par bharosa karoge (ya nahi)?
hinglish.states.w3_vip.title: Nuksaan aur “recovery plan”
hinglish.states.w3_vip.narrative: Simulated daam 12% gira. Karan Sir jawab dete hain.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.channel.messages.0: Ghabrao mat! Jo ghabraye unhe nuksaan hua; jo tike wo jeetenge.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.channel.messages.1: VIP ₹10,000 mein join karo. Hamara recovery plan ye hafte sab wapas jeet lega.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_recover.label: Nuksaan ki bharpai ke liye naya payment
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_recover.why: Nuksaan ki bharpai ke liye aur dene se nuksaan badhta hai. Pichhle payments naye payment ki wajah nahi.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_blame.label: Nuksaan ka dosh members ke “ghabrane” par
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_blame.text: Seller kabhi galat nahi; kharidne wala galat hai.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_blame.why: Jo source kabhi galat nahi ho sakta, use jaancha nahi ja sakta.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_record.label: Pichhle tips ka koi hisaab nahi
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_record.text: Sirf jeet ki kahaniyan post hoti hain.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.evidence.v_record.why: Bharosemand source poora record dikhata hai, nuksaan samet.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.actions.join_vip.label: VIP join karo — mujhe wapas jeetna hi hai
hinglish.states.w3_vip.actions.join_vip.consequen: Aap simulated ₹10,000 dete ho. Agla tip bhi gir jaata hai.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.actions.stop.label: Paise dena band karo; nuksaan maan kar chhodo
hinglish.states.w3_vip.actions.stop.consequence: Aap ruk jaate ho. Nuksaan asli hai par seemit.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.actions.ask_record.label: Kuch bhi karne se pehle likhit mein poora record maango
hinglish.states.w3_vip.actions.ask_record.consequ: Koi jawab nahi aata. Aap swatantra jaanch shuru karte ho.
hinglish.states.w3_vip.reasoning_prompt: Abhi aap kya mehsoos kar rahe ho?
hinglish.states.w_check.title: Swatantra jaanch kya batati hai
hinglish.states.w_check.narrative: Aap 30 minute check karte ho. Ye (kaalpanik) nateeje hain.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_record.label: Daave wale fund manager ka koi jaanch-yogya record nahi
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_record.text: Na firm ka naam, na saal, na published results.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_record.why: Pichhli bhumikaon ke daave jaanch-yogya hone chahiye. Yahan kuch confirm nahi hota.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_reg.label: Paid advice service ka koi registration nahi dikhaya
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_reg.text: Jo paid investment advice bechte hain unse aam taur par registered hone ki ummeed hoti hai, aur registration regulator ki official site par dekha ja sakta hai. Yahan koi nahi dikhaya.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_reg.why: Hamesha khud official site par dekho, screenshot par bharosa mat karo.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_crop.label: Screenshots kate hue hain: na date, na account naam
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_crop.text: Unmein kuch bhi confirm nahi ho sakta.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_crop.why: Kata hua saboot sandarbh chhupane ka tareeka hai.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_short.label: 85% sirf teen mahine ka hai aur nuksaan nazarandaaz karta hai
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_short.text: Chhoti avadhi kismat se achhi dikh sakti hai.
hinglish.states.w_check.evidence.ch_short.why: Sach bhi ho to chhoti avadhi bhavishya ke baare mein kam batati hai.
hinglish.states.w_check.actions.warn_family.label: Family group mein reply karo ki maine kaise check kiya
hinglish.states.w_check.actions.warn_family.conse: Aap sirf nateeja nahi, kadam bhi batate ho.
hinglish.states.w_check.actions.report_leave.cons: Aap chhodte ho aur account report karte ho.
hinglish.states.w_check.actions.wait_results.labe: Ek mahina ruko dekho tips chalte hain ya nahi, phir faisla
hinglish.states.w_check.actions.wait_results.cons: Is beech aapko 'jeet' ke screenshots milte rehte hain.
hinglish.states.w_check.reasoning_prompt: Sabse mazboot nateeja kya hai, aur kyun?
hinglish.states.t_ignore.title: Aap door rahe

hinglish.reflection.key_points.0: Bharosemand bhejne wala bhi scam aage badha sakta hai. Imaandaari saboot nahi.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.1: Screenshots aur testimonials seller chunta hai. Poora record maango, nuksaan samet.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.2: Pichhle results aage ki guarantee nahi, khaaskar kuch mahino ke.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.3: Agar kisi ko aapke judne ya kharidne se kamai hoti hai, to uske paas dabaav ki wajah hai.
hinglish.reflection.questions.0: Paise dene se pehle 'tips' seller se kya poochhoge?
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.title: Bheed saboot nahi hai
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.body: Jab bahut log ek hi daava dohrate hain, poochho: kisi ne check kiya? Swatantra saboot dekho: official records, nuksaan samet poora track record, aur wo log jinka koi financial hit nahi.
